jobs.description:
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use innovative technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. For an update on your status, or to confirm your application was submitted successfully, please login to your candidate portal. NOTE: Amazon works with a high volume of applicants, so we appreciate your patience as we review applications

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
• Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
• Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
• Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
• Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
• Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

jobs.description:
The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large-scale problems through creative solutions.

The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground-up re-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.

What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,
and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of
end-to-end systems exposure.

You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. You will shape foundational decisions in an active re-architecture program with high visibility to senior leadership

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and own end-to-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product managers, principal engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and working software.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying gaps in existing systems, proposing solutions, and delivering results with a high bar for quality and operational excellence.
Participate actively in code reviews, contribute to team best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the technical bar across the team.
Operate with a good sense of ownership — monitoring systems you build, responding to operational issues, and iterating quickly to improve customer and partner experience.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of sellers? As a Software Development Engineer II on the Seller Compliance team at Amazon, you will design, build, and deliver features that help solve complex regulatory challenges across Amazon's EU marketplace. You will own your work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into clear, simple solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing new feature development with refactoring and operational improvements to maintain a healthy and extensible codebase.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business and customer needs, ensuring the solutions you deliver are well-aligned with both technical and product requirements.
- Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the quality bar for the team and helping newer team members ramp up effectively.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, contributing to your team's operational excellence and reducing recurring support costs.
- Evaluate emerging tools and approaches — including generative AI capabilities — to improve development workflows, and make recommendations for adoption that increase team productivity and code quality.

About the team
The Unified Services for Selling Partners team builds the platform that powers third-party service discovery and purchase for Amazon sellers navigating complex regulatory and compliance requirements across global marketplaces. We own the E2E compliance services platform serving over 57,000 sellers across 786,000+ services. Our engineers work at the intersection of compliance, seller experience, and platform scalability, collaborating closely with product, policy, and program partners to translate evolving regulatory landscapes into seamless, scalable technical solutions. We are an inclusive, collaborative team where every engineer has a voice in shaping our technical direction and architectural decisions. If you want to build systems that operate at Amazon scale, solve real-world regulatory challenges for sellers worldwide, and help define the future of compliance technology, this is the place to be.
